name: Vampire - Multiattack (Vampire Form Only) - Failures
description: Flavor text for failures a action

results.text: A desperate swipe misses as the foe dodges the vampiric assault with uncanny reflexes!
The vampire's strike falters, his movements hampered by a sudden flash of holy light.
Both attacks whiff past their mark, the target vanishing into the night's mist.
A misstep in the shadows leaves him vulnerable as his blows land harmlessly on empty air.
His fangs and claws clatter against armor with a hollow, impotent clang!
